description: SSOT of every published evidence figure and the tracked script that produces it. A figure with no producer is a defect. Every producer.script path must be git-tracked.

binding.daemon_binary_sha256: sha256 of the executable the harness addressed (Linux /proc/<pid>/exe; macOS lsof txt)
binding.source_commit: git rev-parse HEAD of the tree the binary was built from
binding.rule: a bundle is unbound unless run_id, daemon_binary_sha256 and source_commit are all present and daemon_binary_sha256 equals the independently hashed addressed exe

producers.note: Refuses to invent a percentage. Requires --run-dir of a named tools/list capture. The unpublished 95 % dashboard figure has no producer and is retired until a named run is supplied.
Existing tracked sanitiser. Does not produce continuity or Big-10.
